description: P3 coupling. The overlord consumer pins the Delivery sentence that commits by `hivemind:molt` and validates per the Validation Procedure section. The open-plan-pr consumer pin carries the outcome discriminator — Blocked (`stage: validation`). WHICH report outcome forces exit 1 is the claim-carrying antecedent; pinning only the obligation leaves the exit rekeyable on a different outcome with the suite green.

source.pattern: Open PR only when: plan complete, validation passed, version bump included if required, branch pushed

consumers.pattern: commits by `hivemind:molt`, one per wave; validation per `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/definitions.md` (Validation Procedure)
Exit 1 with blocker if the procedure returned the Worker Report — Blocked (`stage: validation`)
